correctness.rationale: Three-move EF equivalence preserves profiles of counts of size-1, size-2, and size>=3 E-classes, each capped at 3. This gives 63 nonzero canonical profiles for all finite nonempty E-structures, since a 3-move spoiler can exhaust at most 2 previously used classes of a given size category before each fresh move, and >=3-member classes always supply remaining matched elements. For each canonical profile Q_0 is the complete equality/E atomic diagram, Q_{r+1}=(Q_0,{Q_r(tuple+v):v in A}); induction on FO formulas identifies its Q_3 root signature with quantifier-rank<=3 truth theory. Independent separately written Python enumerated the 63 profiles, computed their exact Q_3 signatures and obtained 21 classes with max minimum representative cardinality 9. Sharpness from rank3 sentences requiring >=3 distinct E-classes and every class >=3 members forces >=9. The 63-profile exhaustive computation is valid because of the proved universal EF reduction, not merely tested size bounds.
